name: finwise
description: FinWise — мобильное приложение для учёта финансов (React + TypeScript + Express API)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared && tsc -p server --noEmit && tsc -p client --noEmit
